planPhases.title: Implement filterProducts in src/utils/productFilters.ts
planPhases.notes: Implemented search (case-insensitive trim), category (exact match, 'All' skips), inStockOnly, and sort (price-asc/desc, rating-desc). Build passes. Integration tests in filtering.test.tsx and sorting.test.tsx still fail because event handlers (phases 2-3) are not yet wired.

planPhases.title: Wire event handlers in FilterPanel.tsx (search, category, inStockOnly, Clear Filters)
planPhases.notes: Wired onChange for search input, category select, inStockOnly checkbox, and Clear filters button (resets full FilterState to defaults including sortBy). filtering.test.tsx and clearFilters.test.tsx now pass. sorting.test.tsx still fails — awaits phase 3 (SortSelect).

planPhases.title: Wire onChange handler in SortSelect.tsx
planPhases.notes: Renamed _onChange parameter to onChange and wired it to the select's onChange event, casting e.target.value to FilterState['sortBy']. All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Wrap setFilters in App.tsx to reset page to 1 on any filter change
planPhases.notes: Added handleFiltersChange callback in App.tsx that calls setFilters(next) and setPage(1). Passed it to FilterPanel as onChange and to SortSelect as onChange={(sortBy) => handleFiltersChange({...filters, sortBy})}. All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.
